title: CTAS input fingerprints
description: One digest per published record over every database row its dossier was built from, with the release-wide context digest and the build record (how the release was built: full or incremental). The next release reuses a record's dossier bytes only while its fingerprint, the context and its clock-dependent score terms are unchanged; a sample of reused records is rebuilt and compared every cycle.

score_as_of.description: The release's score clock (score_clock.score_as_of); the next release's clock rule compares against it.

context_digest.description: sha256 over the bound code hashes, the source-universe definition fields the projection reads and the analysis switch.

full_rebuild_at.description: When every dossier was last rebuilt from the database (this release when mode is full).

sample_mismatch_at.description: The last time a re-verified dossier did not reproduce; full rebuilds continue for full_rebuild_hours after it.

decisions.description: Why records were rebuilt: new, changed (fingerprint), clock (time-dependent score terms), cross-event (messenger signals or collector screens), unreadable; and unchanged (reused).
